description: This file contains SQL DDL statements to create types, tables, views, and triggers related to an order entry schema in an Oracle database. It defines object types and nested table types for entities like products, inventory, customers, orders, and categories, along with views that incorporate object references and nested collections.

classes.name: warehouse_typ
classes.description: Object type representing a warehouse with id, name, and location.

classes.name: inventory_typ
classes.description: Object type for inventory items associating product and warehouse, with quantity on hand.

classes.name: inventory_list_typ
classes.description: Table of inventory_typ objects, representing a list of inventory items.

classes.name: product_information_typ
classes.description: Object type for product details including nested inventory list.

classes.name: order_item_typ
classes.description: Object type for individual order line items, with a reference to product information.

classes.name: order_item_list_typ
classes.description: Table of order_item_typ objects, representing a list of order items.

classes.name: customer_typ
classes.description: Object type for customer data, including nested orders and contact info.

classes.name: category_typ
classes.description: Object type for product categories with description and ID.

classes.name: subtype_list_typ
classes.description: List of references to category types (category_ref_list_typ).

classes.name: corporate_customer_typ
classes.description: Subtype of customer with an additional account manager ID.

classes.name: leaf_category_typ
classes.description: Subtype of category type representing leaf categories with overridden describe method.

classes.name: composite_category_typ
classes.description: Subtype of category for composite categories with subcategory references.

classes.name: catalog_typ
classes.description: Subtype of composite_category_typ representing a catalog with a method to get catalog name.

methods.name: category_describe
methods.description: Method returning a string description of the category type.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Method returning the catalog name, overrides superclass method.
